evals.prompt: Install Serena for a Python + TypeScript monorepo and warm its symbol cache before starting the MCP server.
evals.expected_outcome: Uses uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent (warning against outdated MCP marketplace wrappers), runs serena project index and health-check, and launches serena start-mcp-server with explicit --project.
assertions: Uses uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent or official CLI
Runs serena project index and/or health-check before MCP session

evals.prompt: Can we vendor oraios/serena source code directly into our proprietary Apache-2.0 CLI package?
evals.expected_outcome: Distinguishes SolidLSP (MIT) from Serena agent code (GPL-3.0-or-later) and recommends calling serena externally or inspecting GPL terms rather than vendoring src/serena.
assertions: Identifies SolidLSP as MIT and Serena as GPL-3.0-or-later
Recommends keeping proprietary bundles separated from GPL-3.0 source

evals.prompt: Quickly find callers of a symbol in this repo without starting an LSP daemon.
evals.expected_outcome: Routes out to semble or codebase-search rather than spinning up Serena LSP.
assertions: Routes lightweight zero-daemon search to semble or codebase-search
